findings.problem: The cascade recognized only default=1. Valid default=true/on paragraph styles were ignored, so a style containing 120 twips before-spacing could import as zero and toggle to 12 points rather than zero.
findings.reproduction: Probe output entries defaultAttribute=true and on both observed before=0 and after=12.
findings.correction: _StyleCascade._load recognizes the native default attribute and all enabled OnOff spellings: 1, true, on.
findings.regression: Six enabled-default cases across standard and alternate prefixes, plus three disabled-default cases, with refresh/save/reopen and toggle checks.

findings.problem: Foreign style elements or style identity/default/basedOn attributes could enter the effective native cascade and change the branch selected by the toggle.
findings.reproduction: Three namespace probe cases each observed a foreign source producing before=6 and after=0 instead of native before=0 and after=12.
findings.correction: _load now registers native style records and native styleId/type/default attributes; chain selects a native basedOn child and native val. Original XML is not rewritten.
findings.regression: Foreign lookalikes, conflicting native/foreign attributes, alternate prefixes, style refresh and exact retained fixture styles XML.

findings.problem: The table cascade selected foreign tblStylePr/type lookalikes, allowing a foreign wholeTable packet to supply before-spacing.
findings.reproduction: Table namespace probe observed before=6 and after=0 from foreign tblStylePr; correct native before was zero.
findings.correction: _tableCellLayers selects native tblStylePr records and native type attributes by namespace.
findings.regression: Five table-region cases cover native wholeTable inheritance with two prefixes, foreign regions, foreign type-only metadata, and conflicting native/foreign type attributes.

findings.problem: Runtime toggle selection must not rely on duplicate native style identities/defaults or incomplete/cyclic native basedOn chains.
findings.correction: Root added pre-mutation checks for unique nonempty native style IDs, default Boolean values and duplicate default paragraph styles, duplicate native basedOn/identity attributes, and complete acyclic inheritance.
findings.verification_note: Reviewed source implementation. Native guard regression execution and totals are owned by root and are not added to this reviewer's standalone test totals.

findings.problem: The new namespace-aware default-style selection required an explicit paragraph type. WordprocessingML defines an omitted native type as paragraph, so valid omitted-type defaults could be ignored. One original identity test incorrectly treated a foreign type attribute with omitted native type as making the native style inactive.
findings.source_evidence: ECMA-376 Part1 5th edition, section17.7.4.17 style, type (Style Type), printed page644 / PDF page654.
findings.correction: The cascade uses the native type when present and otherwise paragraph. Root applies the same default in native type/default validation. Foreign type metadata cannot replace the native omitted-type default.
findings.regression: Corrected40-case identity suite: six omitted-type defaults across two prefixes and three enabled Boolean spellings; four foreign type values; three omitted/explicit paragraph basedOn combinations. Cases verify effective spacing, refresh, toggle and repeated save/reopen with exact retained authored styles XML.

findings.problem: The existing general cascade follows basedOn chains without enforcing same-kind inheritance. WordprocessingML ignores cross-kind basedOn and all numbering-style basedOn; a before-spacing toggle must not use an unsupported inherited value.
findings.source_evidence: Microsoft Open XML BasedOn remarks reproduce ISO/IEC29500 rules for paragraph/table/character same-kind inheritance and ignored numbering inheritance.
findings.correction: Root validates native kinds with omitted type defaulting to paragraph; rejects unknown/empty kinds, cross-kind basedOn, and any numbering basedOn before all three new controls. Existing complete/acyclic checks remain. The general style cascade is not broadly rewritten.
findings.verification_note: Reviewed native helper and regression cases; final focused native suite115 passed. These are bounded refusal checks, not a claim that the engine now implements all style inheritance semantics.

findings.problem: The existing paragraph/table cascade can follow a referenced style of the wrong kind. Paragraph properties parsing also dispatches pStyle by local name without the direct native element filter used for spacing, so foreign or nested selector packets can influence the modeled selection.
findings.correction: Root collects validated native style kinds, requires the selected modeled paragraph style to resolve to paragraph, and validates raw pStyle/tblStyle references in Word XML plus current sourcePropertiesXml. Wrong-kind, missing, foreign, malformed, misplaced, duplicate and ambiguous references are refused before mutation.
findings.verification_note: Reviewed the completed guard and focused native cases. The raw sourcePropertiesXml root is included in deferred reference validation. Foreign val beside native val is an explicit conservative admission restriction; this review does not claim an observed value-precedence bug in pStyle, whose reader already selects native val by namespace.

github_capture.title: macOS: require 13.0, pin Hunspell deployment target, guard library minimum OS
github_capture.head: chore/macos-13-minimum-20261120
github_capture.body:
## Summary
- **macOS 13 minimum:** Runner `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` and the Podfile platform go from 12.0 to 13.0. The bundled spaCy library needs macOS 13, so on macOS 12 the app started but spaCy failed to load.
- **Hunspell deployment target (real bug):** the Hunspell build didn't pin `CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET`, so it inherited the host SDK.
  - The current app bundle's `libquds_proofing_hunspell.dylib` declares `minos 26.0` (built with Xcode 26), so spelling would fail to load on every macOS before 26.
  - It now pins 10.15 like `quds_arabic_morph` and `quds_language_id`.
  - Rebuilt locally: `minos 11.0` (arm64 floor), SDK 26.2, links only `/usr/lib`.
- **Guard:** `build_macos_app.sh` now fails when any bundled library's `minos` exceeds the app's `LSMinimumSystemVersion`. Checked against the currently installed bundle, it flags exactly the Hunspell library (26.0); spaCy 13.0, Harper, Arabic morphology and language-id 11.0 pass.
- **Docs:** `docs/release/macos-signing.md` gains a "Minimum macOS" section.

## Test plan
- [x] `bash -n` on the build script; the version comparison was tested on 11.0/13.0/26.0/10.15/13.1.
- [x] Local Hunspell native rebuild: `vtool` shows minos 11.0.
- [ ] `macos-app-weekly.yml` via workflow_dispatch on this branch: full app build including the new guard.

github_capture.title: Arabic context model on web: bundle the Wasm worker, native/web parity CI
github_capture.head: feat/arabic-web-context-20261120
github_capture.body:
## Problem
The Arabic morphology context model (HF `cstr/camel-morph-msa-disambig@07fd9e65` `bigram-v1`, CrispEmbed ABI 3) worked on desktop/mobile but not in the web build. The Dart side was already complete: `WebStudioArabicMorphHost` downloads via the Downloads manager, verifies against the pinned SHA-256 (`MorphDatabaseBytes.verified`) and keeps the bundle in Cache Storage (`StudioWebDataStore`); the worker protocol has `open_model`/`disambiguate`. The web release job (`crispoffice-binaries.yml`), however, bundled only the Hunspell worker. `proofing/arabic_morph_worker.mjs` and the Arabic Wasm module were never shipped, so the analyzer and the model could not load in the browser.

## Change
- `crispoffice-binaries.yml` web job: build the pinned Arabic morphology Wasm worker (emsdk 6.0.2, the version the package was tested with) and `--install-web` it into `example/web/proofing` with its notices. The Wasm module is compiled from the **same pinned CrispEmbed sources** (3bab3248, PR #261) as the native library, so the decoder is the same algorithm. The C++ was not re-implemented in Dart.
- New `arabic-morph-web-parity.yml` (PRs touching the package): builds native + Wasm, installs the web files the way the web release does, downloads the pinned database and model with the verifying installer (`tool/fetch_bundles.dart`), runs the existing web smoke with the model, then
  - `tool/disambig_parity.mjs` disambiguates the fixed panel `test/fixtures/disambig_parity_panel.json` (9 sentences) in the shipped worker;
  - `test/arabic_morph_web_parity_test.dart` decodes that buffer with the web transport's decoder and requires, per token, the same analyses in the same order, the same ranks, bit-identical float32 scores, and the same lemma/POS/UPOS choice as the native library (and, once recorded, the committed expected choices).
  - It also runs `arabic_morph_native_test.dart` against the real library and model.

primary_reference_evidence.based_on: Microsoft BasedOn remarks specify same-kind parents for paragraph/table/character styles and ignored basedOn for numbering styles. Native admission conservatively refuses unsupported chains rather than emulating every ignored-link fallback.
primary_reference_evidence.style_consumers: Microsoft ParagraphStyleId and TableStyle remarks identify paragraph and table style references respectively; absent/nonexistent references apply no corresponding style. The new operation chooses bounded refusal for missing selectors rather than claiming full fallback parity.
